changelog: Fixed persistent ARM32 SIGABRT (__stack_chk_fail) in CFileLoader::SetRelatedModelInfoCB by clamping DFF NodeName chunks and GetNameAndDamage output to <= 19 chars (matching libGTASA char name[20] stack buffer)
Added 512px texture downscaling for 0.3.DL custom RGBA textures on 32-bit Android to reduce VRAM usage and prevent OOM on 2 GB RAM devices
